SELECT A.APPT_NO, A.EMP_NO, E.EMP_NM, A.APPT_TYPE, T.CD_NM AS APPT_TYPE_NM , A.FROM_DEPT_CD, FD.DEPT_NM AS FROM_DEPT_NM , A.TO_DEPT_CD, TD.DEPT_NM AS TO_DEPT_NM , A.APPT_DT, A.STATUS FROM TB_APPOINT A JOIN TB_EMP E ON E.EMP_NO = A.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT FD ON FD.DEPT_CD = A.FROM_DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_DEPT TD ON TD.DEPT_CD = A.TO_DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CODE T ON T.GRP_CD = 'APPT' AND T.CD = A.APPT_TYPE
AND A.APPT_TYPE = #{apptType} AND A.APPT_DT >= REPLACE(#{apptFrom}, '-', '') AND A.APPT_DT <= REPLACE(#{apptTo}, '-', '')
ORDER BY A.APPT_DT DESC
